description: Laboratory experiments are based upon the corresponding theory course EEPC-302. An updated list of experiments is floated by the course coordinator before the beginning of each semester.
outcomes: Understand the basic hardware knowledge of working with the 8085 microprocessor and its applications.
Describe the operation and hardware knowledge of working with the 8051 microcontroller and its applications.
Analyse the generation of different waveforms.
Understand A/D conversion and multi-byte mathematical operations.
